set: C: surface and detail, native-size crops of the ten keys

issues.where: the outer metal ring, especially the right and lower-right arc
issues.what: The grazing highlight breaks into evenly spaced radial wedges, exposing the mesh facets beneath the concentric brushing.
issues.fix: Increase the ring's segment count and smooth its normals so the anisotropic brushed highlight moves continuously around the rim.

issues.where: the steel balls beside the bumpers, upper-left crop
issues.what: The balls read as milky beads rather than opaque steel: the lower halves wash to gray and the same circular hotspot repeats on each sphere instead of reflecting its surroundings distinctly.
issues.fix: Use opaque polished steel with tighter contrast and resolve nearby bumper, floor, and rail reflections separately on each ball.

issues.where: the wire ramp where it enters the circular parking garage, upper-right crop
issues.what: Bright wire ends cross the garage lip and stop in midair over the interior; there is no visible receiver or continuous ball path through the joint.
issues.fix: Open a slot in the rim and terminate the wires at a mounted track receiver with a clear running transition.

issues.what: The glowing lens has convincing vertical ribs, but the dome and collar stair-step in polygonal bands that are visible at native size.
issues.fix: Subdivide and smooth the lens and collar profiles while preserving the molded ribs and the local red spill.

issues.where: the office-tier floor near the bumpers and flipper
issues.what: The heavy, even speckle looks like exposed carpet rather than artwork under a polished pinball coating; the floor does not pick up a distinct reflection from the nearby bright rims.
issues.fix: Keep the carpet pattern in the print beneath a lower-roughness clearcoat and let nearby hardware register as faint, distinct reflections.

issues.where: the front-edge warning card and Unemployment Office drain plaque
issues.what: The small print is conspicuously soft at delivery size, especially on the warning card, so the physical lettering does not hold up in its own close-up.
issues.fix: Bring the front plaques into the focal plane for this shot and keep the lettering sharp in the decal texture.
